relation_decisions.target_truth: The learner-worthy contrast is accuse sb of sth/doing vs charge sb with sth, with charge typically more formal/legal. Current Relation owner is internally inconsistent because its target_sense_id/target_definition point to charge=price/fee while other fields claim the accusation verb. Re-anchor to the correct charge accusation sense and fix the syntax field.

If retained, compare verb address sb/an audience with speak to sb/an audience and express the typical register/directness difference. Current owner anchors a noun 'formal speech' source sense against a verb speak sense, so the semantic objects/POS are misaligned.
Keep the sense-specific near-paraphrase address an issue ≈ deal with an issue, with address emphasizing directing attention/action and deal with being broader handling/coping.

decisions.target_truth: Keep one main accusation sense and one canonical high-value pattern accuse sb of sth/doing sth. Remove the duplicate/incomplete construction 'accuse of + sth'. The accuse↔charge boundary is useful only after its Relation owner is re-anchored to the correct charge accusation sense.

Keep accustom sb/oneself to sth as the verb pattern. Treat be accustomed to sth/doing as the high-value participial/adjectival accustomed pattern rather than pretending it is an ordinary inflectional pattern of the active verb without distinction.

Keep acknowledge truth/existence, acknowledge receipt, express thanks, and formally recognize status/authority as legitimate branches. Remove exact semantic duplication of the express-thanks meaning between Active and secondary_senses.

Keep two learner-worthy centers: familiarity/knowledge of sb/sth and a person one knows slightly. Fold 'a relationship less intimate than friendship' into the acquaintance-person/familiarity meaning rather than maintaining it as a separate Active sense. Prefer natural acquaintance with sth over overpromoting less-common pattern wording.

Core should be obtain/gain/come to possess something, not restrict acquisition to one's own effort/ability. Cover skills/knowledge and ordinary possession/business/assets under that broader semantic center; keep radar target acquisition outside the main learner map.

Preserve plain across meanings: side-to-side, opposite side, and throughout/across a range. Model come across and get across as separate high-value phrasal/construction knowledge because their meanings are not ordinary collocations of the plain adverb sense.

Do not collapse distinct POS/meaning families into one noun sense. Learner-worthy target includes noun act=deed/action; verb act=take action/behave; verb act=perform/pretend at appropriate depth; noun Act=law; and lower-priority noun act=part/performance unit. Core may compress around doing/performing but cannot erase the branches.

Keep ordinary action/process toward a result. Restore recognition of academic/scientific action=effect/operation (e.g. action of a drug/substance/mechanism) rather than merging it into generic action. War 'action'=fighting may remain lower-priority recognition rather than equal main depth.

Keep ordinary activate=make/start/enable something to become active or operational as the main learner meaning. Demote specialist 'make radioactive' from the main learner-active map unless domain-specific use later warrants it.

Center the adjective on being in action/operation/participation and cover ordinary currently operating/engaged/in effect uses alongside active disease where useful. Do not promote rare noun 'an active' and grammar noun active voice as equal main learner senses; keep them recognition/reference as appropriate.

Keep ordinary activity/action/state or level of being active as learner Knowledge. Demote chemistry-specific activity/reactivity from the main general learner map to reference/explore unless a domain-specific need explicitly calls it back.

Use gender-neutral 演员 / performer for the theatrical sense, not 男演员. Preserve academic/general actor=participant/agent/player in a process, system, negotiation, policy, etc. as a high-value familiar-new sense.

Preserve three useful branches: adapt sth to a purpose/situation; adapt to conditions; adapt a work for another medium. Keep one semantic structure object per distinct pattern and remove duplicate adapt-to constructions / redundant representations of the same pattern.

Keep add sth to sth/add to sth, add that..., add up, and add up to. Represent mathematical addition coherently rather than as a malformed 'vi. + to' sense. Remove duplicate add to + sth collocation objects that express the same pattern.

Keep noun addict as the main headword meaning. Do not make rare/formal causative verb addict sb/oneself to the Core merely for completeness. The learner asset should connect to high-value addicted to sth/doing family knowledge at the proper owner later; Current Core '上瘾者或使上瘾' overstates the deprecated verb branch.

Preserve ordinary noun addition and arithmetic meaning at suitable depth, but represent in addition and in addition to explicitly as high-value discourse/prepositional phrase structures rather than merely collocations attached to 'act of adding'.

Use one semantic center: sufficient/good enough in quantity or quality for a purpose. 'Acceptable but not excellent' is an important pragmatic nuance of adequacy, not a separate independent learner-active meaning. Keep adequate for sth / adequate to do sth patterns.

Keep physical stick/adhere to and figurative adhere to rules/principles/standards as the two main learner branches. Treat devoted follower/supporter as lower-frequency recognition. Remove duplicate physical adhere-to constructions and organize one structural pattern across its semantic branches.

Restore the ordinary/high-value branches currently absent from Active Knowledge: manage/run/supervise or formally carry out; and administer/give/apply medicine, treatment, a test, oath, etc. Demote archaic/formal administer to the sick=give help from being the sole Active sense. Core should compress formal management/execution/delivery.

Preserve acknowledge truth and allow entry/admission branches. Explicitly represent high-value complement structures admit that..., admit doing sth, and admit to doing sth. Keep formal admit of sth only at low recognition/reference depth rather than equal main learner weight.
